statement: A cafe owner made a scatterplot of the number of hot drinks sold each day against the outdoor temperature. The line of fit is $y = 410 - 6.5x$, where $x$ is the temperature in degrees Fahrenheit and $y$ is the number of hot drinks sold. According to the line of fit, how many hot drinks will be sold on a day when the temperature is $48^\circ\text{F}$?

choices.misconception: I worked out 6.5 times 48 to get 312 and gave that as the answer, forgetting to subtract it from 410.
I subtracted 6.5 and 48 from 410 separately instead of multiplying 6.5 by 48 first.
I added 6.5 times 48 to 410, but the line has a negative slope, so warmer days mean fewer hot drinks.

hints: Substitute the temperature for $x$ in the equation of the line.

solutions.reliable: Substitute $x = 48$: $y = 410 - 6.5(48) = 410 - 312 = 98$. The line predicts about $98$ hot drinks.

author: Devansh Sanghavi
